title: Myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI)
description: Myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) shows how well blood flows through your heart muscle. During this outpatient test, you receive a small injection of radioactive tracer and rest for 15-20 minutes, then return for imaging scans. You may also undergo stress testing (exercise or medication) and repeat imaging to compare blood flow at rest versus exertion. The entire process takes 2-4 hours and is painless. Results help your doctor identify areas of poor blood flow or previous heart damage. You go home the same day with no radiation side effects.
